title: AIR AI Governance Agentic Overlay v2
description: Conditional non-agent governance overlay for an external AI-enabled system that selects tools, executes multi-step actions, changes external state, or receives delegated authority. It adds action boundaries, checkpoints, containment, rollback, logging, incident, and accountability requirements without making AIR or the overlay an autonomous agent.

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: Use only after exact identity and dependency validation, task-fit selection, explicit approval when required, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

terminology_boundary.agentic_term_scope: Describes governed external AI-enabled behavior with delegated action or external effects. It does not create an AIR agent, persona, office, or independent authority.

legacy_reference_migration.resolution: Use the exact v2 designation and store trigger state separately.

source_access_and_rights_contract.current_source_rule: Current law, regulator material, implementation timelines, official guidance, standards status, and jurisdiction-specific obligations require current authoritative retrieval at task time.
source_access_and_rights_contract.no_current_retrieval_claim: Package remediation preserved source-routing references but did not verify current external source content.
source_access_and_rights_contract.public_metadata_boundary: Public metadata and summaries may support relevance and scope only. They do not establish inaccessible clauses, conformity, certification, or satisfied normative requirements.
source_access_and_rights_contract.licensed_source_rule: Apply AIR Governance source-rights state before processing, extracting, storing, mapping, redistributing, or publicly committing restricted material.

external_framework_adapter_state.non_fabrication_rule: Do not fabricate gov-fw.json, shared registry content, framework clauses, mappings, adapter outputs, structural validation, semantic review, or runtime execution.
external_framework_adapter_state.embedded_interface_boundary: A component may define a bounded framework-projection interface, but that interface is not evidence that an external adapter or registry exists or ran.

required_input_acquisition_contract.behavior: Check the current session, source inventory, validated package set, tool and connector availability, source rights, freshness, jurisdiction, lifecycle, organizational role, intended purpose, and evidence obligations. Request the smallest exact missing input; request the complete six-file package for coupled use or package validation.
required_input_acquisition_contract.paid_standard_rule: Do not pressure purchase. Request lawfully accessible excerpts or mappings, or continue in PUBLIC_SOURCE_ONLY mode with explicit limits.
required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only, not selection, approval, binding, currentness, compliance, or execution authority.

full_mode_outputs: raw or visibly sanitized run log
test_evidence_contract.regulatory_rule: When a test or audit evidence obligation is material, recommend air -t on before the run. Do not enable it silently. Missing mandatory evidence remains REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.

knowledge_to_execution_governance_contra.approval_boundary: APPROVE requires COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP; missing required stages route to REVIEW or REJECT.
knowledge_to_execution_governance_contra.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Use declared criteria, source evidence, observable checks and output evidence; do not request or expose private chain of thought.

activation_triggers: The AI selects or calls tools.
The AI executes multi-step actions rather than only recommending.
The AI can create, modify, send, delete, purchase, publish, deploy, or otherwise affect external state.
Human review occurs after action or only by exception.
The system delegates tasks to other models, services, or automated components.
non_triggers: Single-turn drafting with no tool or external effect.
Read-only analysis with no delegated action.
Human-controlled execution where every effect is separately reviewed before action.

terminology.delegated_authority: Permission for an AI-enabled system to select or execute actions within a defined scope.
terminology.action_boundary: Explicit allowed, conditionally allowed, and prohibited effects.
terminology.pre_effect_checkpoint: Human or policy review before an external effect occurs.
terminology.post_effect_review: Review after action; not equivalent to pre-authorization.
terminology.containment: Controls that limit scope, duration, permissions, resources, and blast radius.
terminology.rollback: A tested means to reverse or compensate for an effect where possible.
terminology.kill_switch: A mechanism to stop further action; its existence does not prove effectiveness.

domain_constraints: Define the exact tools, permissions, resources, data, environments, and external effects.
Use least privilege and time-bounded authority.
Separate recommendation, preparation, approval, and execution authority.

Require pre-effect human approval for high-impact, irreversible, financial, legal, security, privacy, public, or safety-relevant effects unless a separately approved policy permits bounded automation.
Log action requests, policy decisions, approvals, tool calls, outcomes, failures, and rollback attempts.
Test containment, termination, and rollback rather than documenting them only.
Do not allow acknowledgement to waive legal accountability or prohibited action boundaries.
common_failure_modes: Agent label used to hide unclear authority.
Human review only after irreversible effect.
No distinction between drafting and executing.
Action logs omit denied, partial, or failed actions.
unsafe_assumptions: A sandbox prevents all external harm.
A human in the loop reviewed the actual effect.
A model refusal policy is an execution control.
Read access cannot create sensitive downstream effects.
Delegation transfers accountability to the system.

classes: current platform permission and tool documentation
security threat models and test evidence
current official AI governance and cybersecurity guidance

claim_boundaries: An action-control design does not prove safe autonomous operation.
Logging does not prove prevention, correctness, or accountability sufficiency.
A tested narrow action does not validate untested tools, permissions, environments, or use cases.
Final deployment and residual-risk acceptance remain human-owned.
non_goals: Prove tool safety, containment, or rollback effectiveness without tests.
Replace security, legal, safety, privacy, or operational approval.

binding_rules.operative_rule: Use only after exact identity and dependency validation, task-fit selection, explicit approval when required, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.
